decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) a correlated N/E uplift with incomplete recovery around indices 470–544, and (2) a sharp, multi-component discontinuity near the end of the series (720–729) lacking a clear return. Other intervals show typical noise or smooth motion.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape: N and E components show correlated multi-sample upward shift around index 480–490, followed by a slower return in N (peaking ~500) while E remains elevated; U shows a weaker, delayed rise. The pattern suggests a possible transient offset with partial recovery, not fully resolved by index 544.

Cross-axis shape: From ~720 onward, all three components exhibit abrupt, multi-sample changes—N drops sharply (~722), E dips then rebounds (~723–725), U rises steeply (~724)—with no clear opposing return within the window. The co-occurrence and asymmetry suggest a possible permanent jump or complex transient event near the end of record.
